item.title: [DEVELOPING] LiteLLM SQL injection CVE-2026-42208 actively exploited
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from CISA KEV. CISA lists a LiteLLM SQL injection flaw as actively exploited; attackers can read and possibly modify the proxy database, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?search_api_fulltext=CVE-2026-42208

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Langflow CORS origin validation flaw CVE-2025-34291 actively exploited
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from CISA KEV. CISA lists a Langflow origin validation error as actively exploited; permissive CORS with a SameSite=None refresh cookie lets a malicious webpage call the refresh endpoint with credentials. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?search_api_fulltext=CVE-2025-34291

item.title: [DEVELOPING] LiteLLM command injection CVE-2026-42271 actively exploited
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from CISA KEV. CISA lists a LiteLLM command injection flaw as actively exploited; any authenticated user, including holders of low-privilege internal-user keys, can run arbitrary commands on the host. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?search_api_fulltext=CVE-2026-42271

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Langflow authorization bypass CVE-2026-55255 actively exploited
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from CISA KEV. CISA lists a Langflow authorization bypass as actively exploited; an authenticated attacker can run any flow belonging to another user by specifying the victim's flow ID. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?search_api_fulltext=CVE-2026-55255

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Langflow CVE-2026-0770 remote code execution actively exploited
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from CISA KEV. CISA lists a Langflow flaw (inclusion of functionality from an untrusted control sphere) as actively exploited; remote attackers can execute arbitrary code on affected installations. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?search_api_fulltext=CVE-2026-0770

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Ray code injection CVE-2025-62593 actively exploited
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from CISA KEV. CISA lists a Ray code injection flaw allowing remote code execution as actively exploited; developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed via Firefox and Safari. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?search_api_fulltext=CVE-2025-62593

item.title: [DEVELOPING] MLflow SSRF CVE-2026-64849 actively exploited
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from CISA KEV. CISA lists an MLflow server-side request forgery flaw as actively exploited; attackers can reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive the response status and body. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?search_api_fulltext=CVE-2026-64849

item.title: [DEVELOPING] LiteLLM MCP endpoint authentication bypass CVE-2026-59822 actively exploited
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from CISA KEV. CISA lists an improper authentication flaw in LiteLLM's MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint as actively exploited; an unauthenticated attacker can open an authenticated MCP session with an arbitrary Bearer token. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?search_api_fulltext=CVE-2026-59822

item.title: [DEVELOPING] TeamPCP trojanizes LiteLLM releases 1.82.7 and 1.82.8
